sql_reading_A.note: ACADEMIC_TERMS is the driver; the parameter is looked up
sql_reading_A.sql: SELECT t.TERM_CODE, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON t.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 1 AND t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 0 GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_PARAMETER
